tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rgyud bla'i rnam bshad sngon med nyi ma sogs chos tshan bzhi bzhugs so// swasti/ bde bar gshegs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// sus kyang ma sgrub gdod ma nas// grub pa sangs rgyas snying po zhes// bstod bkur bsngags pa der phyag 'tshal// 'di don ma lus rtogs par dka'// dka' yang sbyangs nas bshad na shes// shes rab can la phan bya'i phyir// phyir mi ldog par 'chad 'di nyon// zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' nas/ rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo gang yin pa dang*/ de 'dra de gnas gang du bzhugs tshul ji ltar yin pa dang*/ shes bya mtha' dag bden pa gnyis kyi tshul du 'du ba la mkhas par bya'o// dang po ni/ stobs sogs yon tan mtha' dag gdod ma nas rang chas su yod pa'i chos dbyings ye shes so// gnyis pa de gang du bzhugs pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang sems can mtha' dag go /gnas dang gnas pa gnyis ka la yang kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis gnyis te/ kun rdzob pa'i snying po ni gsar du blangs pa'i yon tan can dang*/ don dam pa'i snying po ni gdod ma nas grub pa'i yon tan can no// kun rdzob pa'i sems can rigs drug po rnams dang*/ don dam pa'i sems can ni de dag gi gnas tshul du gyur pa'i chos dbyings ye shes so// kun rdzob pa'i sangs rgyas ni gzugs kyi sku'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par gzhan gyi rnam rig la snang ba de'o// don dam pa'i snying po sangs rgyas dang sems can ni don gcig la 'du ba yin te/ chos kyi dbyings gcig pu de'i spang bya mtha' dag rang bzhin gyi dag na/ yon tan mtha' dag rang bzhin gyis grub dgos pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob pa'i snying po dang kun rdzob pa'i sangs rgyas ni don gcig la 'du ba yin te/ de dag gi ngos 'dzin gzhan snang la skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs su snang ba la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob pa'i snying po re kun rdzob pa'i sems can mtha' dag la yod pa ma yin te/

kun rdzob tu yang snying po ni sgrib pa dang bcas par ngos mi 'dzin pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can ni de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i snying pos ni don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis ka la khyab pa yin te/ gsum po don gcig la 'du ba'i phyir/ gal te snying po'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ de gang la gnas pa'i gzhi'i 'chad tshul mi mthun par byung ba de'i tshe/ gnas pa po snying po'i ngos 'dzin gang zhig gnas kyi khyad par sangs rgyas dang sems can gang du/ dus gang gi tshe khyab byed du yod pa dang med pa'i rnam gzhag gsal por 'chad dgos so zhe na/ bshad pa/ snying pos sems can thams cad la khyab pa dgongs pa can du 'chad pa'i tshe snying po'i ngos 'dzin ni kun rdzob pa'i dbang du bya ste/ skyon gsar spang dang yon tan gsar rdzogs so// gnas ni spyir sems can mtha' dag dang phyogs re tsam yang med pa ni so so skye bo rnams so// dus ni snying po'i rnam gzhag thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe'o// yul can ni rnam shes kyi dbang du bya ste/ snying po'i ngos 'dzin gnyis po gang yin kyang rnam shes kyi mngon sum du mi mthong ba'i phyir/ snying po de 'dra de btags pa bar 'chad pa yang ma yin te/ bshad na/ snying pos sems can thams cad la khyab par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ yang snying pos thams cad la khyab par 'chad pa'i tshe na ngos 'dzin ni rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas te/ skyon dang yon tan la dus nam yang bsal bzhag mi dgos pa de'o// gang la gnas ni don dam pa'i sems can mtha' dag dang sangs rgyas so// dus ni ma mtha' snying po'i phyogs gcig nyams su myong ba'i sgom byung gi ye shes mngon du gyur pa nas so// yul can ni ye shes kho nar nges pa las gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbye bas gsum mo// don dam pa'i snying po'i gnas tshul la gzhi 'bras kyi dbye ba med kyang*/

yon tan rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi dbye ba ni rnam shes mthong tshul las byung ba'o// yang don dam pa'i sems can la snying pos khyab pa dgongs pa can du bshad mi dgos te/ don dam pa'i snying po dang sems can ni don gcig la 'du ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di don dam pa'i bdag tu 'chad pas mu stegs kyi bdag dang 'chad tshul 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ don dam pa'i snying po 'di dam pa'i bdag tu khas len kyang*/ kun rdzob pa'i snying po der khas mi len pa'i phyir ro// yang kun rdzob pa'i snying pos sems thams cad la khyab pa ni dgongs pa can du 'grel dgos te/ dgongs gzhi don dam pa'i snying po la dgongs pa dang*/ dgos pa skyon lnga spangs pa dang*/ dngos la gnod byed ni/ sgrib pa kun spangs pa dang*/ shes bya kun mkhyen pa ni kun rdzob pa'i sems can mtha' dag la yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// gal te snying po la bden pa gnyis su 'byed pa lung las ma gsungs so zhe na/ ma yin te/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyas 'gyur rigs kyi kun rdzob pa'i dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis don dam pa'i dang*/ rnam gzhag bcu'i nang na ngo bo'i don dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i don gyis don dam pa'i dang*/ yon tan dbyer med bshad pa'i gzhung gis kun rdzob pa'i snying po 'chad tshul sogs rgyas par bshad na shin tu mang ngo*// yang bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i rang rkang la don dam pa'i sems can dang snying po'i rnam gzhag mi 'chad la/ dgos pa'i dbang gis drang don du 'chad pa de'i tshe ni/ kun rdzob pa'i snying po dang sems can las ma 'das so// bka' 'khor lo gsum pa'i rang rkang la yang kun rdzob pa'i snying pos tha snyad du snying po'i go chod par 'chad mod/ des sems can mtha' dag la khyab pa ni tha snyad du yang mi bzhed de/ de'i tshe na lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rnam gzhag rim can par bzhed dgos pa'i phyir/ yang 'khor lo gsum par don dam pa'i snying po ni rtag pa/

brtan pa/ g.yung drung nyid du sgra ji bzhin pas 'chad mod/ de yang rgyun gyis dbang du mdzad la/ skad cig las ni de ma thag pa'i rkyen can nyid kyi phyir mi rtag ste/ yum las/ gzugs rtag cing brtan la ther gzugs mi 'gyur ba'i chos can zhig yin na ni/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa de yang don dam pa'i gzugs sogs la dgongs pa'o// de lta na yang 'khor lo bar mtha' 'gal bar bzhed pa ma yin te/ 'khor lo bar par thos bsam gyis gtan la phabs pa de nyid nyams su len tshul ni 'khor lo gsum pa nyid las 'byung bas so// mdor na snying po la rang bzhin rnam dag gi dang*/ glo bur rnam dag gi dbye bas gnyis su 'byed pa mdo gzhung na gsal bar bzhugs pa de'i tshe/ glo bur rnam dag gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i snying pos sems can thams cad la khyab par gsungs pa des ni dgos pa rnam pa lnga 'grub mod/ dngos la gnod byed dmigs pa'i phyir drang ba'i don no// rang bzhin rnam dag gis snying pos don dam pa'i sems can kun la khyab par gsungs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa nyid de/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang*/ dri ma gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde gang du yang sgra ji bzhin pa kho nar nges pas des der khyab pa la dngos la gnod byed kyi tshad ma mi 'chad pa'i phyir dang*/ snying po don dam pa'i ngos 'dzin yang rang bzhin rnam dag las gzhan ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad pa na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan med cing*/ ye shes gcig pu de nyid chos rnams kyi gnas tshul du mkhyen pa ni sangs rgyas kyi ji lta ba mkhyen tshul dang*/ don dam pa'i snying pos don dam pa'i sems can mtha' dag la khyab par mthong ba ni sangs rgyas kyi ji snyed pa gzigs tshul te gzhung nyid na gsal lo// de bas na rgyud bla'i bstan bcos kyi bstan byar gyur pa'i gnas bdun la ni/

kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su phye ba las/ rnam shes kyi snang tshul las ni dang po dang*/ ye shes kho na'i mkhyen tshul las ni don dam par 'jog pa nyid do// rdo rje'i gnas ni phyi ma kho na ste/ snga ma ni kun rdzob pa nyid kyi phyir ro// de skad du yang*/ ston pa bstan pa sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis dkon mchog gsum po la gnyis su 'byed pa dang*/ dag dang nyon mongs ldan phyir dang*// zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis gnas lhag ma bzhi la gnyis su 'byed par bstan pa yin te/ de bzhin nyid la dri ma rang bzhin gyis dag nas med par 'chad pa dang*/ de dang bcas par 'chad pa gnyis byung ba dang*/ byang chub la rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ glo bur rnam dag gnyis su gsal ba dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las la ni sangs rgyas rang gi thugs la bzhugs pa dang gdul bya gzhan snang gnyis su 'byed pa la ni rtsod pa 'ga' yang mi snang ba'i phyir ro// yang gzhan dag na re/ snying po'i ngos 'dzin rtag brtan sogs su bshad pa de shin tu rnam dag gi skabs nyid las gzhan ma yin te/ ji skad du/ zag med mngon par 'du byed kyis// lus kyi skye med rtag pa'i phyir// zhes sogs byung ba de ni 'bras bu'i dus las gzhan la mi srid pa'i phyir zhes zer ba dang*/ yang la la dag rtag brtan sogs sems kyi chos dbyings med dgag la dgongs pa yin te/ stobs sogs yon tan ni rtag pa sogs su 'chad mi nus pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// 'di ni mi 'thad pa la gnyis te/ 'chad tshul dang po mi 'thad pa dang*/ gnyis pa mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ ji skad du/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// zhes gzhi dus snying po rtag brtan du bshad pa kho nar ma zad/ 'bras dus kyi snying po rtag brtan du bshad pas gzhi lam gyi snying po yang des 'grub pa yin te/ don dam pa'i snying po dus gsum pa can la ngo bo'i sgo nas mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba cung zad kyang yod par 'chad mi nus pa'i phyir/

kun rdzob pa'i snying po ni sa dang po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar chos sku gsar mthong mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba bshad pa'i phyir na/ yon tan gyi sgo nas mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba yod par 'chad nus so// de lta mod kyi snying po'i 'chad tshul gnyis ka la yang rtag brtan sogs kyi mtshan nyid du gang bshad pa de tshang ba yin te/ gnyis ka la yang 'khor bar 'ching byed du ma zad ma rig bag chags kyi sa'i dbang gis skye 'chi rga ba mtha' dag yod ma myong ba'i phyir/ 'o na byis pas de lta bu'i skye 'chi sogs ma spangs par 'chad dgos pa ma yin nam zhe na/ byis pa'i rnam shes kyis ma spangs par 'chad mod/ ye shes la ni skye rga na 'chi'i rgyu dang bcas pa gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i phyir gsar du spangs dgos pa med do// 'o na don dam pa'i sems can srid pa'i bde sdug byed po dang myong ba por mi 'chad na/ de'i byed po dang myong po su zhig la 'chad/ kun rdzob pa'i sems can dag gis srid pa'i bde sdug myong ba'i tshe/ sems can de'i don dam pa'i ngo bo gsal rig gi cha yang chos can de dang grub bde tha mi dad du gnas pa ma yin nam/ kun rdzob pa'i sems can gyis gang myong ba de nyid de'i shes rig gis mi myong ba ci/ myong na ni shes rig de ye shes su 'dod pa dang 'gal/ mi myong na kun rdzob pa'i sems can bems por gyur pa zhig gis srid pa'i bde sdug myong ngam zhes 'dri na/ de'i lan shes dka' ba ni 'di ltar/ theg pa chen po pa dag gis ni rnam shes la srid pa'i bde sdug tu snang ba'i rnam rig las ma gtogs pa'i bde sdug yod pa grub pa'i mthar mi 'chad la/ de'i tshe rnam rig la gnyis te/ kha phyir blta gzung rnam gyi cha dang*/ nang blta 'dzin rnam gyi cha'o// dang po de shes rig tu khas len pa sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' la yin te/ gzugs 'dzin mig shes kyis gzugs mthong bar 'chad pa'i tshe/

gzugs med kyang mthong ba po sems nyid du khas len pa bzhin no// rnam brdzun dbu ma pa yan chad kyi ni/ gzugs 'dzin gnyis med ces bya ba grub pa'i mthar 'chad dgos pas 'dzin pa po shes pa lta ci smos/ dngos por 'dod pa ma yin no// gnyis pa nang blta 'dzin rnam kyi cha ni/ rnam shes thams cad kyi yang ngo bo dang snying po nyid du gnas par khas len mod/ rnam shes kyi yul du gang snang de rig par khas mi len te/ ji skad du/ shes gang gang la sgra don 'dzin// de ni de la rtog pa yin// rang gi ngo bo sgra don yin// de phyir de la kun mngon sum// zhes gsungs so// rnam shes 'khrul pa'i chos ji nyid pa la nang blta ye shes kyi cha re re yod kyang*/ ye shes kyi gsal cha rnam shes kyi ngo bor 'gyur srid pa dang*/ cig shos kyang der 'gyur srid pa ni ma yin te/ gzhan du na/ ye shes srid pa'i bde sdug myong ba por thal ba dang*/ rnam shes kyi ming can yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa de dag zag med kyi yon tan mtha' dag gi sgrub gzhi nyid du thal bar 'gyur pa'i phyir ro// gdod ma'i ye shes de med par glo bur gyi rnam shes 'khrul snang du mi 'byung mod/ gnyis po'i gzhi mthun srid par 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ nam mkha' la sprin dang*/ gser la g.ya' dang*/ chu dwang ba la rnyog pa bzhin no// rnam shes rang gi ngo bo gsal rig tu khas mi len na/ bems po nyid kyi phyir yul ma rig par 'gyur ro zhe na/ ha cang thal ba nyid du mi 'gyur te/ spyir rnam shes ni tshad mas mi 'grub kyang*/ 'khrul pas yod par sgro btags pa nyid du khas len gyi/ rig pa lta ci smos/ yod par yang khas mi len te/ kun rdzob bden pa nyid kyi phyir ro// de lta na 'khrul pa la gzhi med pa'i phyir ye shes la rag ma las par yang 'khrul snang skye bar 'gyur ro// zhe na/ ma yin te/ mtho yor med na mir 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi 'byung ba bzhin no// gdod ma nas grub pa'i ye shes med par 'khrul snang mi 'char zhing*/

'khrul snang gi kha nang blta 'dzin rnam gyi cha de gdod ma'i ye shes su nges par gnas shing*/ gnas pa de nyid gsang sngags pas nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog lam du byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi tshe/ thog mar bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i sgrub gzhi dang*/ bar du de gnyis ka'i ngo bo nyid du lhun gyis grub nas spang bya de dag kha phyir blta'i cha nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du rang zhi rang dag tu 'gro ba yin gyi/ nang blta skyed rdzogs kyi ngo bo nyid du song ba de las logs shig tu kha phyir blta'i cha lam du byas nas spang dgos pa ni ma yin no// dper na nam mkha' med par bum pa dang khang pa sogs kyi snang ba mi 'char mod/ nam mkha' nyid bum sogs kyi ngo bor song ba ma yin pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi stong pa nyid snying por byas pa ni legs pa ma yin te/ snying po'i ngos 'dzin ni yon tan gyi cha nas 'chad dgos kyi/ stong pa nyid rkyang pa la ngos 'dzin de mi rung ba'i phyir/ bod phyi ma snying po'i ngos 'dzin rang bzhin gnas rigs la byed pa yang mi 'thad de/ rigs ni dri ma dang bcas pa'i cha nas ngos 'dzin la/ snying po ni dri ma sel rgyu med pa'i cha nas ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/ de bas na skyon thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing*/ stobs sogs yon tan ji snyed pa rang bzhin lhun grub tu gnas pa'i de bzhin nyid ni/ gzhung 'di'i bstan bya nyid du ngos 'dzin pa'i snying po dngos te/ ji skad du/ de bzhin nyid dbyer med pa'i phyir// thams cad sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes pa'i gzhung 'grel mdo dang bcas pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa nyid do// yang ji skad du/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro ba'i phyir// kun kyang sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa nyid de/ rigs yod phyir na zhes pas dgongs gzhi dang*/

sems zhum sems can dman la brnyes pa dang*// zhes pa dgongs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med ces pas dngos la gnod byed ston no// gal te 'o na bstan bcos gcig tu snying pos sems can la khyab ma khyab kyi 'gal ba can gnyis su 'chad pa ci zhe na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs so so nas snying po'i sems can la khyab ma khyab kyi tshul gnyis gsungs pa de'i dgongs pa/ rje btsun byams pas snying po'i ngos 'dzin la bden pa gnyis su phye nas legs par bshad pa yin no// zhes pa 'di grub pa'o// de ltar des rtsom byed po ni// sngon chad gangs can 'dir ma byon// dge 'dun dpal gyis bskul gyur pa// dge ba'i lo thog rgyas par shog/ //shubhaṃ// // ༄༅// swasti/ rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi nges don sngon med nyi ma zhes bya ba/ bshes gnyen dge 'dun dpal gyi phyag tu springs pa bstan bcos 'di'i ṭī ka gcig rtsom gsung byung na'ang*/ 'di'i ṭī ka sngon chad byung ba rnams la nyung ba'i skyon mi 'dug sngon med pa'i 'od zer gcig gi stong gsum gsal bar byed pa 'di/ khyod nyid kyis bsod nams kyi zong gis thob pa'i phyir thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis gtan la 'beb tshul zab pa dang rgya che ba dgos so// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i rnam bshad mdo rgyud snying po bzhugs so// ༄༅// na maḥshrī su ga ta s+ya gar+bhe yā/

spangs pa'i khyad par/ thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol zhing*/ rtogs pa'i khyad par/ /de nyid thugs su chud gyur pas/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ /yon tan gter mnga' gsum dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// snying po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon tshe khyod la sems can kun la mtshan dpes sbras pa'i sku dang*/ gzhom du med pa'i gsung dang*/ stobs sogs thugs kyi yon tan gnas so zhes log par rtog pa// mang zhig sngon gyi mkhas pas bsal/ sa rngog gnyis dang bu sogs kyi/ phar phyin du rang bzhin rnam dag tsam dang*/ sems can gyi khams snying po yin no ces dang*/ sngags su brtan g.yo kun la snying pos khyab pa'i skabs mi srid do ces/ /dus 'dir khyod gzhung log 'chad pa// gang dag deng 'dir bsal rgyud bla rtsa 'grel dang*/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i lung gis bar bya// de la snying po rnam gnyis te// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// theg pa'i gzhung gang bla med 'khor lo phyi ma gnyis dang sngags/ las// gsal bar gsungs pa de dag go /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung chen las// snying po rnam pa gnyis bstan te// 'khor lo bar par rnam dag dang*/ byang chub ji lta'i mdor spros pa'i mtha'// thams cad bkag pa'i med dgag la// de bzhin gshegs dang sems can dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i snying por gsungs// 'di ni shes bya thams cad la// khyab pa med kyang sems can gyi// chos nyid dri mas dag pa na// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid 'gyur phyir// 'gro kun de yi snying po can/ rje btsun gyis/ mdo sde rgyan du/ 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs pa 'chad pa na/ /de ni snying po dngos min te// yin na 'dus ma byas pa dang*// bems po thams cad sangs rgyas kyi// snying po can du thal bar 'gyur// de ltar yin na de dag kyang*// mthar thug de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur// de phyir de la der btags pa'o// de bas 'khor lo bar pa nas// 'khor lo tha mar bshad pa dang*// mtshungs pa'i bde gshegs snying po ni// gsal bar bstan pa gcig kyang

ldan pa'i don la bstan pas med// gal te yod na don dam pa'i// bden pa spros pa can 'gyur te// chos 'khor gsum pa'i chos kyi dbyings// kun kyang ma yin dgag phyir ro// chos 'khor tha mar bshad tshul la// mdo dang bstan bcos tshul gnyis po// dang po'ang rnam gnyis mdo 'ga' ye shes snang brgyan gyi mdo/ las// brtag cing brtan la ther zug cing*// rgyu gang gis kyang ma skyed pa'i// yon tan drug bcu rtsa bzhi po// kun gyis nye bar spras pa yis// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum po// sems can kun la zhugs ces gsungs// gnyis pa mdo sde 'ga' lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ myang 'das chen po'i le'u bzhi par/ zhig las// sman pa dang ni rdza mkhan gyi// dpe yis dgongs gzhi dgos pa dang*// mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs so zhes// dngos la gnod byed tshad ma yis// snga ma dgongs pa can du bkral// de phyir 'khor lo tha ma yis// bde gshegs snying po'i dgongs gzhi ni// spros pa'i mtha' kun dang bral ba'i// rang bzhin 'od gsal ces bya ba// so so rang gis rig pa yi// ye shes kyi ni myong bya la// gsal bar bshad pa nyid yin phyir// ma yin dgag par 'chad dgos so// de ltar na yang lugs 'di la/ spros bral gyi 'jog mtshams mi 'dra bas/ /spros bral min par mi 'gyur te// 'od gsal nyid la mtha' bral ces// dbu sems gzhung dang theg bsdus/ kun btus/ gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor/ brtag gnyis/ gsang sngags kyi// gzhung chen dag las gsal bar gsungs// bstan bcos su ni bkral tshul la// rje btsun nyid dang 'phags pa yi// slob dpon gang gis bkral tshul lo// dang po theg chen rgyud bla mar// bshad tshul rnam pa gnyis yin te// rnam gzhag rnam pa bcu dang ni// dpe don dgu yi bshad pa'o// dang po rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// rang bzhin 'od gsal zung 'brel la// dag pa dag dang ma dag dang*// shin tu rnam dag dbye ba yis// byang chub sems dang sems can dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes// gsum du phye ba yod mod kyi// sems can kun la bde gshegs kyi// snying pos khyab par bshad pa med// yon tan dbyer med ces bya ba// shin tu dag pa'i gnas skabs dang*// sbyor bar 'phags pa thogs med bzhed// skabs 'dir mnga' bdag rgyal po'i gzugs// ri mor bris pa'i dpe yis ni// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas sogs la// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// med do zhes ni gsal bar bsgrags// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer gyi// dpe yis ji ltar rdzogs sangs rgyas// mngon du ma byas de srid du// yon tan thams can dbyer med pa'i// snying po med par gsungs pa yin// skabs 'dir 'dod chen nyan rang gi

/myong bya min phyir kun rdzob kyi// bden phyir yod ma yin phyir mod// gnyis med ye shes rgyun bcas kyang*// 'dzin rnam nyid phyir don dam bden// ngo bo nyid med smra kun gyis// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ye shes kun// dpyad mi bzod phyir kun rdzob bden// sgyu ma rigs sgrub dbu ma pa// rigs pas sgrubs pa'i med par dgag rtags kyi bsgrub bya dngos yin phyir// don dam bden zhes 'dod pa dang*// rtags kyi bsgrub bya tha snyad nyid// yin phyir phyogs chos nges blo yis// gang gsung don dam bden no zhes// lugs gnyis sngon byung phyi dus su'ang*// de ltar 'dod do rta dbyangs kyis// don dam byang chub sems bsgom pa'i// rim par 'di bkag lo chen gyis// bdag med don dam bden no zhes// zer ba dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i// gzhung lugs min par lung gis bsgrubs// rab tu mi gnas dbu ma pas// rtags kyi bsgrub bya gang gang de// spros pa'i phyogs gcig bkag tsam las// ma 'das phyir na kun rdzob bden// nyid phyir de yod min pa yang*// dgag bya yod ma yin par gsungs// 'o na rab tu mi gnas pas// spros kun bral ba'i stong pa nyid// don dam bden par 'dod dam zhes// zhe na spros pa kun bcom tshe// spros bral yod pa ga la srid// don dam bden pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra dang rtog pas mi 'dzin mod// rnam kun pa'i ye shes kyang*// med par dgag la mngon sum du// 'jug par theg chen chos la med// 'khor lo gsum pa'i chos kyi skad// tshad mar bzhed pa'i dbu ma pas// gzung 'dzin chos dang de bkag pa'i// gzhan sel kun rdzob bden zhes mod// nges don ye shes don dam pa'i// bden par bzhed pa mnyam gzhag dang*// rjes thob bshan 'byed gnyis ka'i skabs// 'o na rigs pas dpyad pa'i ngor// de mi rnyed pa ci zhe na// rigs pa sgra dang rtog pa dang*// nyams myong zag med ye shes phyir// des myong ba la 'jig rten pa'i// thos bsam bsgom pas gnod mi nus// thal rang gzhung gi stong pa nyid// mngon sum rtogs pa'i blo med na// gang gis gang gang spong dang ni// ji ltar spangs dang de spangs pa'i// sa mtshams dbye ba gang yin dang*// sgrib kun spangs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// yod ma yin nam yod na yang*// kun la rmongs par thal zhe na// gang gis spong blo thun mtshams su// mnyam par bzhag las langs blo dang*// gang zhig spong na ma brtags pa// gcig pur nyams dga'i sgrib kun dang*// spangs pa'i sa mtshams so so yi// bsod nams tshogs la 'jug tshe dang*// lung bstan lung ma bstan pa'i chos// gang yang yod ma yin par ni// stong pa nyid du ro gcig par// gyur la ldang blo mi srid pa// de de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so// rgyas par bshad na chos mchog gi

/ye shes stong nyid yul can blos// spong bar byed do gang spang bya// ma 'ongs skye rung chos can te// ji ltar spong na chos mchog blo// stong pa nyid du thim gyur pa'i// bya rdzogs skad cig mthong lam bcu// rigs pa drug bcu'i gzhung gis bshad// de las bzhengs pa'i rjes thob blos// phyi mas sgom spangs spong la 'jug /sa dgu po yi mnyam bzhag las// spang bya che sogs spangs pa yis// rnam grol re re'i 'jug thogs su// rjes thob blo gros rgya che bas// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par byed// de yi de ma thag rkyen ni// sbyor ba'i dus kyi 'phen byed dang*// rtog pa'i sa bon yod pa las// yin no sa brgyad par slebs tshe// de dag med phyir sangs rgyas kyis// 'gog las slong bar mdzad dgos so// 'di yi 'gog pa med dgag tu// zab mo 'jigs rung 'chad pos bshad// langs pa'i ye shes dang po de'i// de ma thag rkyen ci zhe na// yang dag min rtog phra mo yi// bag chags drungs ma phyung las so// sa bdun par ni 'gog pa las// ldang la 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa// sgra don 'dres par 'dzin pa yi// rtog pa gnas ma gyur las te// 'jug la 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa'ang*// sa drug pa yi rjes thob tu// sher phyin lhag par gyur las yin// dbu ma'i lugs la 'gog snyoms kyi// ngos 'dzin stong nyid rtogs blo zhes// bshad na zab mo 'jigs rung min// sa bcu tha ma'i rjes thob blo// stong pa nyid du ro gcig par// song ba rgyun gyi tha ma'i ste// des na rjes thob blo mi srid// rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir chos kyi sku// med dgag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa// yin no gzugs kyi sku 'di dag /mtha' yas yon tan kun rdzogs par// snang ngo gzhan sems kyis ma bsdus// sangs rgyas sems can gang gi yang*// sas ma bsdus pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// ci zhes zer na sangs rgyas kyi// mdzad pa rdza mkhan stobs chen gyi// 'khor lo 'khor ba'i dpes bstan zhing*// sa rnams kun gyi mnyam gzhag ni// mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya rjes ltar// rnam dbye mi phyed pas bstan no// de nas zhar byung 'di bshad pa// sangs rgyas sa ni sgrib kun dang*// bral ba'i med par dgag pa dang*// ma yin dgag la ngos 'dzin pa'i// shing rta'i srol chen gnyis 'dir 'byung*// lugs dang por ni sangs rgyas kyis// gzigs pa'i chos 'ga' yod min phyir// sems can sangs rgyas snying po can// ji ltar yin tshul de mi bzhed// 'on kyang sgrib bcas sems stong nyid// snying po yin zhes 'di na smra// dri ma yod dang sems de yi// rang stong smra ba 'gal ba'i khur// srol gnyis par ni sems can kun// sangs rgyas snying po can no zhes// 'chad la 'gal ba yod min te// 'chad tshul de ma thag der 'byung*// ci phyir zhe na sgrib pa kun// gdod nas zad pa nyid phyir dang*// gzhi dus ye shes gdod ma nas// yod nyid phyir na dri med kyi// shes la yon tan ci mi 'thad// gzhi dus dri med ye shes 'di// dam pa'i don gyi sems can dang*// dam pa'i don gyi sangs rgyas kyang*// yin te sgrib pa kun bral phyir// 'di la thog mtha' dbus med cing*// bsod nams dang ni ye shes kyi// rgyu las ma byung ba nyid dang*// rgyun gyis rtag dang mi zad phyir// dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyun med dang*// rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis 'di kho na// las gzhan gzigs pa med mod kyi// sems can btags pa'i yod nyid du// khas len byas nas tshogs sog dang*// sgrib pa spong dang sa lam dang*// 'jug tshul rim pa dam bca'i tshe// kun kyang sangs rgyas snying po can// yin par dam bca' mi rung ste// dri ma bsal bar byar yod cing*// yon tan bzhag par byar yod phyir// med na rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// glo bur rnam dag dbyer mi rung*// dri mar bcas tshe stobs sogs la// rang gi yon tan yod ma yin// dang po'i sangs rgyas sems can rnams// sangs rgyas gang yin brtag bya'i tshe// sangs rgyas yin te shāka thub kyis// rdzogs sangs rgyas su gzigs phyir te// des ma gzigs pa'i chos kyi dbyings// yod ma yin zhing gang gzigs pa// de nyid gzigs po des bsdus phyir// mdor na dri ma med pa yi// ye shes sangs rgyas las gzhan ci// 'o na sems can ji snyed pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas su thal zhe na// sems can yod par khas len pa// de tshe gzhi dus chos kyi dbyings// sgrib dang bcas phyir sangs rgyas su// khas len byed pa ma yin no// bden gnyis rnam 'byed shes po yis// dri ma kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don du 'jog pa yi// lta spyod rim pa gnyis shes tshe// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces dang glo bur dri ma yis// bsgribs zhes bya ba de gsungs so// re zhig de sbyar ba'i dge bas// chos 'khor gsum pa'i nges don gyi// gnas kun 'gal ba med shes nas// dbu ma'i rtse mo der phyin shog/

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dang po'i sangs rgyas grub pa'i gzhung gi brgal lan/ sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu nges pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa'i// sems can ci yang yod min zhing*// de tshe sangs rgyas dngos yin na// rdzogs sangs rgyas la bsod nams dang*// ye shes tshogs sog mi dgos pa// ha cang thal zhes sgrib pa kun// spong ba don med 'gyur ro zhes// rgol ba'i lan gang bsam bya ba// dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa'i// gsang sngags pa kun lta ci smos// phar phyin smra ba rang rang gi /gzhung las nyams pa ma yin nam// thog mar mngon rtogs rgyan gzhung du// kun rdzob byang chub chen po ni// dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i// ye shes yin par dam bca' nas/ zad med skye med chos kyi dbyings// don dam byang chub chen por bshad// dri ma zad dang skye med na// gang gis gang zhig spong ba dang*// ci yis ci zhig mi skye bar// byas la dgos pa gang zhig yod// dngos po brjod du med pa la// zhes rgol lan du ci zhig btab// don dam byang chub chen po ni// de bzhin nyid du ma bshad dam// de bzhin nyid 'di tshogs gnyis pos// gsar du byas par 'dod dam ci// nyams 'phel bya ba kun rdzob tu// yod par bshad pas chog ces na// kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don// gang dbang btsan pa dpyod la smras// kun rdzob yod min phyir tshogs sog /dgos med nyid du 'gyur zhe na// kun rdzob nyid du gang yod pa// de kun kun rdzob nyid du dgos// de mi dgos na kun rdzob pa'i// sems can kun la sangs rgyas su// snang bas de don mdzad mi rung*// sems can yod pa ma yin tshe// gang gi don dam mdzad ce na// 'bras bu'i don du khas blangs pa'i// rmongs pas brtags pa gang yin pa'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas la mi snang ba'i// 'khrul snang khyad du bsad pa la// rmi lam bu bsad ji bzhin du// phan dang gnod pa med ce na// 'khrul pa'i snang bas 'khrul pa nyid// sel bar byed do sgyu ma yi// mkhan po rang nyid kyis sprul pa'i// bud med la chags sel ba'i thabs// sgyu ma gzhan zhig sprul de bzhin// byams pas rgyud bla'i bstan bcos su// nyon mongs gdod nas zad pa dang*// shes bya thams cad chos dbyings su// rtogs tshe de bzhin gshegs snying gis// sems can kun la khyab bshad nas// dri mar bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa dngos yin la// gnod byed mang du gsungs pa yin// dam pa'i don du sgrib pa kun// yod min pas na kun rdzob tu// sgrib kun sel bar nus pa ni// bden gnyis zung du 'jug par bshad// de tsher ma zad mya ngan las// 'das pa don dam du grub pas// 'khor ba mi dmigs pa de yang*// 'khor 'das rnam dbyer med pa'i don// yang dag kun rdzob pa'i ming can// gnas skabs don dam du bzhag nas// log pa'i kun rdzob sel mkhas pa// de tshe nges don mthar thug gi

/khang bzang chen po mngon sum gyur// de ma gyur pa de srid du// dang po'i sangs rgyas rdzogs sangs rgyas// yin pa ji bzhin mi shes te// sangs ma rgyas pa de srid du// gzhi lam 'khrul med yin mi shes// rang la yod pa sangs rgyas su// ma shes pa dang dri ma rnams// gdod nas med par ma shes pas// kun rdzob pa yi sems can dag /thar chen lam du 'jug dang bral// sgyu ma gdod nas ma grub par// lung gis shes kyang rang rang gi /mngon sum gyis grub ma yin pa// de srid gzhi dus ye shes mchog /chos kyi skur ni shes ma nus// de mthong de shes tshe de nas// rang la sangs rgyas snying po ni// phyogs gcig yod pa de shes so// sngags pas gzhi dus ye shes ni// dri mar bcas dang stobs sogs kyi// yon tan med phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas// min pa kho nar dam 'cha' na// mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis// byang chub rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dam 'cha' dang*// grub zin sgrub par thal ba la// 'dod lan btab pa ma yin nam// de de min sprang po yis// rgyal por rlom dang mi mtshungs sam// ye shes ngo na grub zin kyang*// rnam shes ngo na bsgrub dgos pa// yin no rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid kyis// 'chad pa po yang zhes sogs su// sems can thams cad nga yin par// bshad pas don 'di bde blag 'grub// 'o na mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi// rnam rol mi ston ci zhe na// de ltar ston pa bsod nams kyi// tshogs chen gsar du rdzogs la rag /de ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// ji ltar yin pa smros she na// dri ma zad skye ma byas pa'i// sangs rgyas ji ltar yod pa'ang smros// la la'i mngal gyi mi bdag dang*// khyung gi sgong rgya ji bzhin par// 'chad pa lung gi dngos bstan nyid// yin phyir brtsad pa'i skyon las grol// rdzogs sangs rgyas rjes bsod nams kyi// tshogs sog dgos pa ci zhe na// gzhan snang gzugs kyi sku grub pa'i// phyir yin grub zin grub pa'ang de// 'o na sku gsum ma tshang ba'i// sangs rgyas ha cang thal zhe na// gzhi'i dus kyi sku gsum po// ngo sprod man ngag pa la snang*// zhen pas zhugs nas 'brel pa yis// mi bslu zhes pa lam dus kyi// ye shes gzhi dus sangs rgyas la// 'brel pa nyid du khas len gyi// lam dus 'bras bu la 'brel bar// 'chad pa rigs pa'i gzhung na med// 'khrul ngor dri ma yod pa dang*// gnas tshul rdzogs sangs rgyas pa ni// 'gal med 'chad pa snying po'i mdo// don dam par ni dri ma dang*// sangs rgyas gnyis ka yod min pa// mi 'gal 'chad pa sher phyin mdo// dri mar bcas tshe rdzogs sangs rgyas// yod min pa dang de yod tshe// dri ma kun nas yod min pa// 'khor lo gsum pa'i chos kyi skad// yin no spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod ma shes na// dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes shing*// de ma she na gsang sngags kyi// tshul chen shes pa min zhes gsungs// de phyir don dam pa'i sems can// kun kyang sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shubhaṃ//

// ༄༅// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par nges pa'i gter sgo brgya 'byed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// theg chen thun mong min pa yi// dbu ma rnam gsum kun mthun par// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan med 'di go gyur na// ya mtshan chos kyi gter sgo brgya// phye ba yin no thog mar ni// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang*// don dam 'khrul med nges pa'i don// 'jog tshul gzhung chen so so ba// rnams su ji ltar bshad gang de// phyis byung gtam gyis ma bslad par// shes la ring por thogs mi byed// de phyir kun rdzob tu bden pa// yod na chos kyi dbyings su thal// rtags de mi mthun phyogs las ni// bzlog pa'i shes byed lung las so// chos dbyings ngos 'dzin dbu ma gnyis// mthun par gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// rgyud gyur chos dbyings ye shes te// med par dgag la der mi bzhed// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung du// chos kyi dbyings su ming 'dogs pa// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid las// gzhan yod ma yin de yang ni// kun rdzob bden phyir yod min mod// de med na yang kun rdzob kyi// bden kun 'jog par nus ma yin// dam pa'i don du chos gang yang*// yod min pa las tha snyad du// mi 'byung ci yang yod ma yin// tha snyad sgra rtog ma rig pa// dbang btsan ma yin dam pa'i don// rigs pas dpyad dang yang dag shes// dbang btsan pas na don 'di sgrub// kun rdzob yod ma yin pa la// chad pa'i mtha' thal zhes zer mod// gdod nas yod ma myong phyir dang*// med pa'ang min pas der mi 'gyur// stong nyid yod pa ma yin na// mi stong yod pa thal zer mod// rten 'brel ltos grub chud bsan pas// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung nyams// rang stong mthar phyin gzhung srong tshe// theg mchog rtse mo'i mnyam gzhag tu// ye shes yod par khas blangs na// de nyid des stong min par 'gyur// 'on kyang ji srid gnyis snang gi

/bag chags drungs phyung ma gyur pa// de srid 'phen pa'i dbang gis ni// rjes kyi rnam shes skye bar 'gyur// rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'di med pas// de yod min pa zla grags dang*// zhi ba'i gzhung yin legs ldan yang*// de mi bzhed na rang stong nyams// rang stong phyogs gcig chos grags kyang*// bzhed do gang yod de 'jig tshe// gnas med pas na don byed par// nus pa bzhag tu mi rung phyir// 'on kyang don byed mi nus pa// dngos med nyid du khas len cing*// dngos med min na dngos por yang*// 'dod phyir mtha' bral rtser ma son// dngos por yod la rtag pa yis// khyab na rnam gzhag kun nyams zhes// zer mod don byed par nus na// rgyun gyis rtag go der rtag kyang*// skad cig nyid kyis mi rtag phyir// rnam 'grel mdzad gzhung de ma 'khrul// dper na nyan thos 'phags pa yis// chos kyi bdag med pa rtogs kyang*// de med min par ma rtogs pas// mtha' bral rdzogs pa med de bzhin// sngags kyi dbu mar kun rdzob kun// rang stong nyid phyir yod min mod// don dam chos kun rang rang gi /ngo bos stong na sngags lugs nyams// sngags kyi kun spyod mtha' dag pa// don dam ye shes nyid las te// bskyed rim rtog pa'i rnal 'byor yang*// mthar phyin tshe na chos kyi dbyings// yin no thos dang bsam pa dang*// rtog pa'i sgom yang de'i sngon 'gro// phar phyin theg par bsod nams kyi// tshogs sog tshe na tha mal gyi// snang ba med par byed mi dgos// sngags su de las bzlog pa'o// mnyam gzhag zab mo la zlo'i tshe// chos kyang med ces 'chad pa ni// sngags su mi rung phar phyin du'ang*// dpal ldan zla ba'i gzhung dang mthun// dbu ma gsum du kun rdzob bden// yod ma yin pa 'di shes na// byed mdo sems tsam lugs su'ang*// de shes pa ni rtogs pa sla// med par dgag pa'i stong pa nyid// dbu mar yang ni don dam par// mi 'dod kho nar ma zad kyi// de gsum gzhung du don dam par// don byed nus pa don dam gyi// bden pa'i mtshan nyid du 'chad pa// 'di la khyad par yod ma yin// sems tsam gzhung du shes pa las// ma gtogs phyi rol don med cing*// shes pa rgyun dang skad cig ma// gnyis las gzhan med phyi ma bden// bye mdo rags rgyun rigs pa yis// dpyad tshe med phyir yod ma yin// rdul dang shes pa phyogs dang ni// dus kyi cha med don dam par// don byed nus phyir de las gzhan// rigs pas dpyad tshe yod ma yin// 'jig rten lugs ni thog med kyi// bag chags brtan las byung kun bden// grub mthas brtags dang 'phral gyi ni// 'khrul rgyus bslad kun med phyir brdzun// grangs can gtso bo shes rig dag

/kho na bden phyir don dam ste// nyer gsum rdzun phyir kun rdzob nyid// rgyang 'phan mngon sum gyis mthong ba// kho na don dam bden pa ste// ma mthong lha dang dmyal ba sogs// rdzun phyir kun rdzob bden zhes 'dod// bye brag pa'ang rdzas kho na// don dam bden yin gzhan kun rdzob// mdor na grub mtha' 'og ma yi// don dam gang yin gong ma ba'i// kun rdzob nyid du 'chad ces pa// phal cher yin no mtha' gcig tu// nges pa med do gang zag gi /bdag med 'chad tshul ji bzhin no// sngags su mnyam gzhag snang bcas tshe// rten 'brel sna tshogs gang shar ba// sgyu ma lta bur bshad pa'i phyir// kun rdzob bden zhes 'chad pa dang*// chos dbyings nyid phyir don dam pa'i// bden par 'chad ces zer ba byung*// snang mkhan rang blo gnyis med kyi// ye shes su gyur ma gyur las// bden brdzun so so ba nyid de// gang snang shes pas bsdus phyir ro// yul dang yul can kun bral ba'i// rang stong med dgag chen po 'di// sngags kyi lam dang bden pa gnyis// zung 'jug ces byar mi bzhed mod// dgos med min no rang gzhan gyi// lta ba ngan pa kun bzlog phyir// rtog pas gang bzung 'di min zhing*// gang 'di mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i// thams cad mkhyen blo'ang mi srid ces// zab mo'i mdo dang bstan bcos las// yul can zhen pa kun bral ba'i// gzhan stong ma yin dgag chen po// sngags kyi lam dang bden pa gnyis// zung 'jug kho nar ma zad kyi// gang 'dis mi bzlog grub mtha' pa'i// lta ngan gud du lus pa med// thogs med gzhung du kun gzhi yi// rnam shes bden par 'chad mi rung*// chos kyi dbyings las gzhan med cing*// yang dag min rtog nyid phyir brdzun// gang la stong pa nyid rung ba// zhes sogs don ni chos skyong gis// kun gzhi'i ye shes zla grags kyis// med par dgag pa'i stong nyid la'o// mdor na sangs rgyas sar yod pa// kun bden thogs med mched kyi gzhung*// sa der gang yang yod min pa// zab mo 'jigs rung 'chad po'i lugs// yin no min na sangs rgyas sa'i// chos kun ji ltar rang gis stong*// gsang ba 'dus par 'od gsal gyis// kun rdzob sbyangs nas de 'og tu// zung 'jug bzhed pa zla grags kyi// dbu ma'i gzhung dang mi mthun mod// dbu mar sgyu ma rigs grub dang*// rab tu mi gnas pa gnyis su// 'byed mod rigs grub rang rgyud pa'i// rang lugs min pa gzhung na gsal// mi gnas pa la rgyun bcad dang*// zung 'jug mi gnas par phye nas// dang po sngags su dgag bya ste// gnyis pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i lugs// rab tu mi gnas pa de ni// bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan na// zung 'jug bshad du mi rung phyir// dbu ma 'bring po las ma rgal// bod kyi dbu ma phyi rabs pas// bsgrub bya nges pa'i blo tshad mar// 'dod des gsang ba 'dus pa yi// 'od gsal dgag bya slar bzlog byas// klu sgrub thogs med gsang sngags kyi// nyams len dbu ma don gcig cing*// rigs pas dpyod tshul so so bas// ma chod sgro 'dogs cang yod min// lta ba la ni thos bsam gyis// gtan la phab dang bsgom 'byung gis// nyams su myong bya so so ba// yod pa sngags dang byams pa'i gzhung*// thal rang gzhung du de las bzlog

/sngags su thabs mkhas mang po yis// lta ba nyams su myong gyur nas// rjes su thos bsam rigs pa yis// sgro 'dogs bcad nas ngo sprod byed// pha rol phyin par de las bzlog /rnam par rtog pa kun bral ba'i// zhi gnas so so rang rig gi /ye shes nyid las ma 'das mod// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab dang*// zung du 'brel bar ma byas na// grub mtha'i dbang las gang zag gi /bdag tu rtog pa nyid srid phyir//
